name: Gospel Cauliflower Bake
subtitle: From Aunt Geniel
notes: This recipe, from Aunt Geniel, is like the gospel, too good not to share.

steps.title: Boil the cauliflower
steps.body: In a pot, boil 4–5 minutes: **1 head cauliflower**, cut into florets, **3 cups water** and **1 tsp salt**.

steps.title: Mix the sauce
steps.body: Mix: **1 medium onion**, chopped, **1 Tbsp sugar**, **½ tsp salt**, **½ tsp pepper**, **16 ounces crushed tomatoes** and **1 cup sharp cheddar cheese**, shredded.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.body: Add onion and tomato mixture to the cauliflower. Pour it all into a buttered casserole. Top with more cheese.
